To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the receiver channel and the time interval measurement circuitry of pulsed TOF laser radars can be integrated on one chip and that the accuracy of the laser radar is limited by the accuracy of the time interval measurement.
We have developed an integrated receiver and TDC chip set that realizes an accurate pulsed timeofflight laser ranging system with millimetre-level accuracy within a 11 km range.
we have demonstrated an accurate and highly integrated receiver chip set for pulsed laser ranging and time interval measurement.

the development of new high-precision integrated circuits for pulsed laser ranging and imaging applications.

the development of accurate and highly integrated pulsed time-offlight laser radar and scanner chip sets for applications in the areas of industrial measurement and robotics, automotive, and security.
the design and implementation of high performance integrated circuit solutions for pulsed time-offlight laser ranging and imaging.

the presented chip set is the world's first integrated chip set that implements a complete receiver channel for pulsed TOF ranging.
the developed chip set represents a major step forward in the development of accurate pulsed timeof-flight laser radar and distance sensors.
the receiver chip set is a very accurate and highly integrated solution for pulsed time-offlight laser ranging and distance measurement.

we have successfully developed the key components for the realization of an integrated laser scanner or radar.

the pulsed time of flight distance measurement method is a promising alternative for applications where high measurement accuracy is needed and the cost of the system must be kept low.
